correctness.rationale: For odd m, sum_p v_p(m)/p <= log(m)/(3 log 3)=b log_2(m). Writing n=2^(k-t)m and x=m/2^t gives exact deficit (k/2)(1-x)+x(t/2-S(m)) >= ct+(k/2-ct)2^-t >=ct+bk2^-t, with c=1/2-b>0. Convex minimization yields c log_2 k+gamma. Competitor n=2^(k-t)(2^t-1), t=ceil(log_2 k), yields (log_2 k+2)/2. Each maximizing t and relative shortfall therefore satisfy explicit bounds. Independently computed D via smallest-prime recurrence for k=2..16; sample gaps k=2:3,k=8:384,k=12:7168,k=16:122880. Finite checks do not prove all-k bounds.
residual_risks: Independent checks are bounded, not proofs of universal statements.
